# Copilot Instructions

## Purpose
- This repository is part of an Obsidian-based second-brain workflow.

## Core Rules
- Read `AGENTS.md` before significant changes.
- Use the smallest relevant context first.
- Keep changes scoped; avoid broad refactors unless requested.
- Verify relevant build/test/lint commands before finishing.
- Surface ambiguity instead of guessing.

## Documentation Workflow
- Repo files are implementation truth.
- Obsidian notes are long-term memory:
- `01-Projects/RustCommerce/overview.md`
- `01-Projects/RustCommerce/current-state.md`
- `01-Projects/RustCommerce/review.md`

## Safety Rules
- Do not invent architecture details.
- Prefer small, verifiable changes.
- Report uncertainty clearly.
